title: ServiceNow (NOW) Unveils Autonomous Security to Accelerate Growth
excerpt: ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) has quietly built one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity businesses in the industry, and on August 4, it made that ambition explicit....
content_html:
ServiceNow (NYSE:NOW) has quietly built one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity businesses in the industry, and on August 4, it made that ambition explicit. The company rolled out six new Autonomous Security solutions built to catch and fix threats before they turn into breaches, tied together under what it calls Shift Zero. The timing lines up with a security unit that is already outgrowing dedicated cybersecurity vendors, and the announcement explains why.

Bull Case: A Security Business Already In The Room

ServiceNow's security and risk franchise crossed $1 billion in annual contract value, backed by Q2 2026 subscription revenues of $3.88 billion (up 23% year-over-year in constant currency) and a remaining performance obligation base of $29 billion. CEO Bill McDermott notes it is growing faster than top standalone cybersecurity peers, aided by a 98% renewal rate. Those products were included in 16 of the company's top 20 deals, and cyber solutions appeared in 80% of its largest contracts overall. McDermott put it plainly: "we're in the party now."

The new release leans into that position. The average enterprise runs more than 70 separate security tools, and ServiceNow is trying to fold that sprawl into a single, governed system spanning exposure management, identity, cyber-physical assets, incident response, and compliance. Acquired technology does the heavy lifting: Armis brings real-time visibility across billions of connected devices, and Veza's Access Graph maps permissions across human, machine, and AI identities. Where a detection-focused vendor can flag a threat, ServiceNow's configuration database can trace which system, owner, and workflow the fix actually touches.

Bear Case: Growth Story Meets A Bigger Incumbent

The stock's recent bounce hides how much ground it still has to make up. Shares remained down 41% over the trailing 12 months even after jumping as much as 13.8% in the week of July 31, when ServiceNow beat guidance and raised its full-year subscription revenue outlook to $15.76 billion. That kind of gap between a strong quarter and a still-depressed share price points to a deeper worry: if AI agents can run enterprise workflows on their own, investors question how much terminal value an expensive workflow software stock deserves, no matter how good the next print looks.

The Autonomous Security rollout does not fully answer that worry yet, because it is not finished. Several of the pieces ServiceNow is counting on to make the "most complete" claim stick, including the Tier 2 SOC AI Specialist, the Vulnerability Resolution AI Specialist, continuous control monitoring, and cryptographic asset compliance, are not scheduled to ship until December this year. Until then, the platform's promise of governing every asset, identity, and agent in one motion rests partly on capabilities customers cannot yet test, leaving a gap between what ServiceNow announced and what it can currently prove in production.

content_html_zh:
ServiceNow（纽约证券交易所股票代码：NOW）悄然建立了业内增长最快的网络安全业务之一，并于 8 月 4 日明确表达了这一雄心。 该公司推出了六种新的自主安全解决方案，旨在在威胁变成漏洞之前捕获并修复威胁，并在所谓的“零转变”下捆绑在一起。 这一时间安排与安全部门的规模已经超出了专门的网络安全供应商的规模，该公告解释了原因。

公牛案例：安全业务已经在房间里

ServiceNow 的安全和风险特许经营权的年度合同价值超过 10 亿美元，这得益于 2026 年第二季度 38.8 亿美元的订阅收入（按固定汇率计算同比增长 23%）和 290 亿美元的剩余履约义务基础。 首席执行官 Bill McDermott 指出，得益于 98% 的续订率，该公司的增长速度比顶级独立网络安全同行更快。 这些产品出现在该公司前 20 笔交易中的 16 笔中，网络解决方案出现在该公司最大合同的 80% 中。 麦克德莫特直言不讳地说：“我们现在就参加派对了。”

新版本倾向于这个立场。 一般企业运行超过 70 个独立的安全工具，ServiceNow 正试图将其整合为一个涵盖暴露管理、身份、网络物理资产、事件响应和合规性的单一受管系统。 获得的技术承担了繁重的任务：Armis 带来了数十亿联网设备的实时可见性，而 Veza 的访问图则映射了人类、机器和人工智能身份的权限。 当专注于检测的供应商可以标记威胁时，ServiceNow 的配置数据库可以跟踪修复实际涉及的系统、所有者和工作流程。

悲观案例：增长故事遇到更大的现任者

该股最近的反弹掩盖了它仍有多少空间需要弥补。 尽管在 7 月 31 日当周，ServiceNow 超出预期并将全年订阅收入预期上调至 157.6 亿美元，股价上涨了 13.8%，但过去 12 个月股价仍下跌 41%。 强劲的季度和仍然低迷的股价之间的这种差距指向了更深层次的担忧：如果人工智能代理可以自行运行企业工作流程，投资者就会质疑昂贵的工作流程软件股票应得多少最终价值，无论下一次打印看起来有多好。

自主安全的推出还没有完全解决这个担忧，因为它还没有完成。 ServiceNow 指望做出“最完整”声明的几个部分，包括 Tier 2 SOC AI Specialist、漏洞解决 AI Specialist、持续控制监控和加密资产合规性，预计要到今年 12 月才会发货。 在那之前，该平台承诺一次性管理每项资产、身份和代理的承诺部分取决于客户尚未测试的功能，从而在 ServiceNow 宣布的功能与目前在生产中可以证明的功能之间留下了差距。
